videos.description: US stocks fell on Wednesday, with chipmakers leading declines after stronger than expected consumer price data raised concerns that the Federal Reserve may need to lift interest rates more aggressively than expected in coming months. Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan joins to discuss the bank's latest earnings. MWAG CEO Meredith Whitney examines the state of the US consumer. Mandeep Singh of Bloomberg Intelligence reacts to Anthropic's pre-IPO investor day and the latest comments from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Plus - Allspring's Nate Miles shares the findings from the firm's 2026 retirement study. All on the latest episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Rep. DelBene Says GOP Spending Shows Defensive Shift
videos.description: Rep. Suzan DelBene (D-WA), DCCC Chair, says Republicans are in “triage mode” and moving resources to defend seats they already hold. Rep. DelBene says Democrats are making spending decisions based on race-level data and conditions on the ground as the House map expands. Rep. DelBene says the DCCC is prioritizing frontliners, incumbents and races where it has already invested before adding support to newly competitive contests as more resources come in. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Voters Are Feeling a Deeper Inflation Squeeze: Duppler
videos.description: Mattie Duppler, Founder and President of Forward Strategies and spokesperson for The Ledger Project, says a rate hike is more likely than not after the latest CPI report came in modestly higher than expected. Duppler says the data itself matters less politically than how Americans are experiencing higher prices for groceries and gas. Duppler says consumers had a pandemic-era financial cushion when prices rose in 2022, while today they are increasingly using credit cards and savings to cover higher costs. Duppler thinks that financial pressure is what voters will be thinking about as they head to the polls. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
